entities.name: Vladimir Putin
entities.explicit_context: Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin (born 7 October 1952) is a Russian politician and former intelligence officer who has served as President of Russia since 2012, and previously from 2000 to 2008. He was also Prime Minister of Russia from 1999 to 2000 and again from 2008 to 2012, making him one of the longest-serving leaders in modern Russian history.

entities.name: Xi Jinping
entities.explicit_context: Xi Jinping (born 15 June 1953) is a Chinese politician who has been serving as the General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and President of the People's Republic of China since 2012. He is the paramount leader of China and has been described as the most powerful Chinese leader since Mao Zedong, overseeing China's economic growth and international relations.

The company is known for its electric cars, energy storage systems, and solar panels, and has become one of the world's most valuable automakers by market capitalization, revolutionizing the automotive industry with sustainable transportation solutions.

entities.name: Mao Zedong
entities.description: Test case for same name in multiple languages
entities.explicit_context: Mao Zedong (26 December 1893 – 9 September 1976) was a Chinese communist revolutionary who was the founder of the People's Republic of China (PRC) and served as its chairman from 1949 until his death in 1976. He was also the chairman of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and is considered one of the most influential figures of the 20th century, known for his role in the Chinese Revolution and the Cultural Revolution.

entities.name: IBM
entities.explicit_context: International Business Machines Corporation (IBM) is an American multinational technology corporation founded in 1911. The company is known for its computer hardware, software, and services, and has been a major player in the technology industry for over a century, contributing to the development of modern computing and artificial intelligence.

entities.name: Apple Inc
entities.explicit_context: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company founded by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, and Ronald Wayne in 1976. The company is known for its consumer electronics, software, and services, including the iPhone, iPad, Mac computers, and various software products, and is one of the world's most valuable companies.

entities.name: Elon Musk
entities.explicit_context: Elon Reeve Musk (born 28 June 1971) is a South African-born American entrepreneur and business magnate who is the founder, CEO, and chief engineer of SpaceX, CEO and product architect of Tesla, Inc., and founder of The Boring Company and Neuralink. He is known for his ambitious projects in space exploration, electric vehicles, and sustainable energy.

entities.name: Emmanuel Macron
entities.explicit_context: Emmanuel Jean-Michel Frédéric Macron (born 21 December 1977) is a French politician who has been serving as President of France since 2017. He was previously Minister of the Economy, Industry and Digital Affairs from 2014 to 2016 and founded the centrist political party En Marche! (now Renaissance) in 2016, becoming the youngest president in French history.
